questions.prompt: Your session has entries a, b and c, and the leaf is c. You go back to b and send a new message. What does the file hold, and what does the model see?
options: The file holds a, b, d; the model sees a, b, d
The file holds a, b, c, d; the model sees a, b, c, d
The file holds a, b, c, d; the model sees a, b, d
The file holds a, b, d; the model sees a, b, c
questions.explanation: Going back only moves the leaf to b. The new entry d has parent b, so the file keeps c, and the path from the leaf to the root is d, b, a.

questions.prompt: What does branch(id) do in the session manager?
options: It copies the entries after id into a new file
It deletes every entry after id
It rewrites the parent of the last entry
It moves the leaf to id and changes nothing else
questions.explanation: The code is this.leafId = branchFromId. Only the pointer moves, so no entry is deleted or rewritten.

questions.prompt: pi loads a saved session file. Where does the leaf start?
options: At the last entry in the file
At the first entry in the file
At the entry with the smallest id
At the entry that has the most children
questions.explanation: On load the leaf is set to the last entry in the file, so a resumed session continues from the newest message.
